at_least_one_detail: At least one detail is required
total_debit_and_credit_must_be_equal: Total debit and credit must be equal
total_debit_and_credit_must_be_equal_des: Total debit and credit must be equal
cannot_delete_main_account_desc: Main accounts are part of the core chart of accounts and cannot be deleted. You can still edit its name or deactivate it if you no longer use it.
activate_confirm_desc: The account will be selectable again on new transactions. Existing balances and history are unaffected.
deactivate_confirm_desc: The account stays in all reports and past transactions but can no longer be picked on new ones. You can reactivate it any time.
